_comment: autotest_config.json for swift-package-manager-swift-6-4-0-release. Schema v1.7. Auto-fixed on 2026-09-15 — aligned to actual Swift 6.4.0 scanner output (correlation bd49c789-6006-4b36-971f-3a97e7280772).

scan_output._comment_total_libs_scanned: Optional. Expected total number of libraries scanned with comparison operator.

dependency_tree._comment_expected_total_dependencies_num: Optional. Expected number of dependencies with comparison operator. Operators: gt (>), gte (>=), lt (<), lte (<=), eq (==). If not provided, this check will not be performed.
dependency_tree._comment_expected_dependencies_number: Optional. Expected number of dependencies with comparison operator. Operators: gt (>), gte (>=), lt (<), lte (<=), eq (==). If not provided, this check will not be performed.
dependency_tree._comment_expected_transitive_dependencie: Optional. Expected number of transitive dependencies. Swift 6.4.0 scanner emits a flat tree — all resolved packages appear as direct with 0 transitives.
dependency_tree._comment_dependencies_names_list: Optional. Check specific libraries in direct dependencies. Operators: eq (==), contains (all items from expected list in actual), in(all items from actual list in expected), nin(actual list does not contain provided libs). If not provided, this check will not be performed.
dependency_tree._comment_expected_package_managers: Optional. Expected package managers in the scan result. Swift 6.4.0 scanner reports 'swift' (not 'spm') as the package manager identifier.

_comment_validate_sca_results: Disabled: Swift SPM scans emit PRE_STEP and VERSIONING findings at INFO level (not ERROR). These are expected characteristics of SPM scanning, not failures.
